description: Support Rep. Josiah Hill's re-election campaign for Minnesota House District 33B. Donate online via ActBlue using card, Google Pay, PayPal, or Venmo, or mail a check to PO Box 932, Stillwater, MN 55082. Sign up to volunteer or door knock with Team Hill. Minnesota residents may be eligible for a full refund of up to $75 ($150 for couples) through the state's Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program. Every dollar helps hold this seat.
